checks.evidence: Titles on all 4 pages, none duplicated; /office-lunch title is "Untitled" and it has no meta description.

Every page has one H1. H2s on /, /office-lunch, /weddings, not /contact. Self canonical on /, /office-lunch, /contact; /weddings points to /weddings-2023. No structured data on any page. Pages meet 2 or 3 of 4.

/: "Copperkettle Catering cooks weekday office lunches and wedding dinners for 20 to 200 guests across Halifax and Dartmouth." /weddings: question headings "Do you do tastings?" and "Do you supply staff and rentals?".
No blog, guides or dated content on any page reviewed: 0, raised to 10 by founder-led relief (owner-chef and a team of six, /).
One kind: Instagram profile (/ footer). The newsletter signup on / is a channel but not one of the five counted kinds.
Same nav on all 4 pages, linking every key page.

findings.finding: The weddings page tells search engines to index an old URL instead.
findings.evidence: /weddings: <link rel="canonical" href="https://copperkettle.example/weddings-2023">. Search Console (pages export): /weddings-2023 has 900 impressions, 0 clicks, position 19.0.
findings.fix: Change the canonical on /weddings to https://copperkettle.example/weddings, and redirect /weddings-2023 to /weddings.

findings.finding: The office lunch page is titled "Untitled" with no description, and is clicked rarely for a query where it shows high.
findings.evidence: /office-lunch title "Untitled", no meta description. Export: "office lunch catering halifax" 4 clicks from 1,600 impressions (0.25%) at position 4.1; the site's non-branded positions 4-10 average 1.0%.
findings.fix: Title: "Office lunch catering in Halifax | Copperkettle". Description: "Boxed lunches or a hot buffet delivered anywhere in Halifax and Dartmouth by 11:45. From $18 per person, minimum 15."

findings.finding: No structured data on any page, so the address, phone and service area aren't machine-readable.
findings.evidence: No JSON-LD or microdata on /, /office-lunch, /weddings or /contact. Address and phone appear as text on / and /contact.
findings.fix: Add LocalBusiness structured data to / with the name, 2140 Gottingen St, Halifax, NS B3K 3B3, (902) 555-0161, areaServed Halifax and Dartmouth, and sameAs the Instagram profile.

strengths: A plain, quotable sentence on the home page says what they do, for whom and where.
Same navigation on every page, linking every service page.
The weddings page answers real buyer questions as headings.
not_observable: Google Business Profile listing, reviews and rating.
Whether /weddings-2023 still returns a page or redirects.
